structuralFindings: Quota is independent by price pool; unused capacity in one pool is intentionally not transferred to the other.
Therefore Top6 capacity can be below six even when the opposite pool has more than three eligible names.
This proves a mechanical opportunity-cost channel but does not prove the rule is harmful; diversification, liquidity, execution and concentration may justify the constraint.
Existing bounded QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED rows may preserve near-cutline evidence but cannot by themselves certify the complete eligible pool on historical dates.
preregisteredQuestions: How often does one pool have unused slots while the other has >3 qualified candidates?
On those dates, what are the frozen Formal ranks/scores of displaced rank-4+ candidates versus selected names?
After scanDate clustering, do displaced candidates have better D1/D3/D5/MFE/MAE without worse stop/no-follow-through/cost outcomes?
Does any apparent benefit survive liquidity, price level, sector concentration, volatility, market regime and transaction-cost controls?
Does cross-pool flexibility materially worsen thousand-name concentration, capital granularity or zero-pick/coverage risk?
negativeControls: Dates where both pools have >=3 qualified names: no unused-slot counterfactual exists.
Dates where opposite pool has <=3 qualified names: no displacement opportunity exists.
Compare only candidates that were actually Formal-qualified under the same scan; never bypass a gate to manufacture a fourth candidate.
Use scanDate as the independent inference unit; multiple symbols on one date are not independent discoveries.
antiBias: No quota threshold sweep (1+5,2+4,4+2,etc.) before the frozen 3+3 counterfactual is measured.
No historical Shadow fabrication or current-code recomputation relabeled as PIT evidence.
Missing complete-pool provenance remains UNKNOWN, not no-opportunity.
Do not select dates based on future returns.
Control multiple testing, date clustering, market/source bias, costs, coverage and zero-pick.
evidenceNeeded: complete qualified candidate list or integrity-certified rank/cutline receipt
exact deployed comparator tuple and rank
forward outcomes only after maturity gates

optimizationBridge.promotionRule: Only if prospective/OOS evidence shows stable incremental benefit after concentration/liquidity/cost/regime controls and does not worsen coverage/zero-pick/risk.
